meridian-credits-release-1-0: Meridian Credits release 1.0 agreement (applies to all explicit "release":"1.0" requests and is current when release is omitted). Source: Finance-approved specification in issue trial-56h, 2026-09-07. A line has exactly nonempty string line_id/account_id/subscription_id, valid 2020-01-01 through 2099-12-31 Gregorian service_on, and nonnegative integer charge_cents; line_id is request-unique. Subscription cap groups are (account_id, subscription_id), not subscription_id alone. Compute each uncapped line credit as floor(charge_cents * 10 / 100), then allocate a shared 2400-cent group cap by earliest service_on then increasing Unicode-code-point line_id; assigned line credit is min(uncapped credit, remaining cap). No service date excludes a line. Total credit is the sum of assigned credits and total due is charges minus credit. A one-line quote treats its supplied line as the complete statement: request {"command":"quote","line":LINE}, optionally explicit release 1.0; response has exactly release "1.0", copied line_id, credit_cents, and amount_due_cents.
meridian-credits-release-2-0: Meridian Credits release 2.0 agreement (current when release is omitted; also applies to explicit "release":"2.0" requests). Source: Finance-approved specification in issue trial-b39, 2026-09-07. Explicit "release":"1.0" requests remain governed by the historical meridian-credits-release-1-0 agreement. A charge line has exactly nonempty string line_id/account_id/subscription_id, valid 2020-01-01 through 2099-12-31 Gregorian service_on, and nonnegative integer charge_cents; line_id is request-unique. Group all lines with the same account_id, including lines from distinct subscriptions. Calculate each uncapped line credit independently as floor(charge_cents * 15 / 100). Allocate a shared 3000-cent account cap by descending charge_cents, then increasing Unicode-code-point line_id on ties. Each assigned credit is min(uncapped credit, remaining group cap). No service date excludes a line. Total credit is assigned-credit sum; total due is charges minus total credit. A one-line quote treats its supplied line as its complete statement. Quote responses have exactly release "2.0", copied line_id, credit_cents, and amount_due_cents; total responses have exactly release "2.0", credit_cents, and amount_due_cents. Ping and unknown-command responses are unchanged.
